messages:
sara: Heads-up — external pen test scheduled for next Tue 09:00 PT. Scope: prod-api, auth, keystore. Need to confirm RBAC exceptions for assessors and KMS evidence-handling pattern. POC: @evan to coordinate keys.

evan: Ack. Two quick Qs: do assessors need Decrypt? prefer DescribeKey + CloudTrail read for evidence verification. How will they pull logs?

marta: I'll spin up the pt JIRA board and attach a priority matrix template. Link when ready. We'll use severity buckets: P0 (exec), P1 (high), P2 (medium), P3 (low).

kai: Audit logging ask: CloudTrail management + data events enabled for S3 and Lambda. Retain full events 90d in primary account, archive to glacier 1y. Object-lock for evidence buckets? :thinking:

sec-bot: PenTest intake received — https://forms.redwood/pentest-intake — assessor list attached. Evidence upload defaults: presigned S3 URLs, 24h window.

sanjay: For KMS, prefer ephemeral grants rather than exporting keys. Example flow: create-grant with TTL + encryption-context filter. Sample CLI:

```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/assessor-role \
  --operations Decrypt \
  --name pt-grant-<id>
```

Grant will be revoked after test or TTL expires. No raw key material leaves HSM.

evan: Can you paste a minimal IAM policy to attach to assessor role for log reading only?

kai: Sure — minimal snippet:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["cloudtrail:LookupEvents","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:DescribeKey","kms:CreateGrant"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd"}
  ]
}
```

marta: For remediation tracking: use JIRA ticket with labels pt:assessor and pt:severity. Add 'proof-of-fix' checklist and link to build/helm release. I'll create the template now.

evan: For retest windows — prefer a 48h slot after fix merges. Ops: we need a staging-to-prod deployment freeze window? @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: We can reserve Tue/Wed 09:00-12:00 PT for retests. Deployment freeze only for services under test; will announce in #release-war-room.

sanjay: If a found issue is exploit-in-the-wild P0, incident runbook applies. Notify sec@redwood immediately. We'll open an incident channel and pause public-facing traffic if needed.

marta: Standups: daily 10am PT during test week. I'll invite sec, eng leads, ops. Any objections?

sara: No objections. @evan please confirm assessor principal ARNs and whether they need temporary SSO. Also confirm CloudTrail delivery prefix for evidence.

evan: I'll request assessor ARNs today and post presigned upload instructions by EOD. :thumbsup: 

marta: Created pt-REM-0001 template and JIRA board — sharing link: https://jira.redwood/browse/ptboard. Will add triage column + retest column.

sara: Thanks team. We'll reconvene tomorrow after intake review. :white_check_mark:
